platform: macOS (Darwin 25.6.0) arm64; Kaggle target: Linux x86_64, 2 vCPU
sdk_version: Official cabt engine from the Kaggle data page (ptcg_engine_playground 'ptcgProgram 22' source; sample_submission/cg Python wrapper)
notes: Local runner calls cg.game directly (no kaggle-environments needed). macOS uses libcg.dylib compiled from the official C++ source (see team_b/README.md); Linux uses the official libcg.so. One battle_start() = one game, so simulator.run_match builds best-of-three. seconds_per_match measured for heuristic vs random on the sample deck.
